title: Measure and Design Consultation Fees: Ridgeline Installation Services Program Table
content:
Every Ridgeline Installation Services contract opens with an in-home measure or design consultation. The figures below are the program terms that attach to that visit: the fee charged when the measure is booked, whether that fee is later credited against the contract price, how much notice earns a refund on cancellation, and how soon the appointment may be set.

| Program | Measure fee (USD) | Fee credited against the contract price | Credit window (calendar days after the measure is completed) | Cancellation notice for a refund (hours before the appointment start) | Fee refunded on a cancellation with that notice | Earliest appointment (calendar days after the booking date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Carpet Installation | 35.00 | yes | 30 | 24 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation | 35.00 | yes | 30 | 24 | yes | 2 |
| Ridgeline Window and Door Installation | 0.00 | no | 0 | 24 | no | 3 |
| Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation | 99.00 | yes | 45 | 24 | yes | 5 |
| Ridgeline Bath Remodel Installation | 0.00 | no | 0 | 24 | no | 5 |
| Ridgeline Roofing and Siding Installation | 0.00 | no | 0 | 24 | no | 5 |

## Reading the table

- A measure fee of 0.00 means the program offers a free consultation. The window and door, bath remodel and roofing and siding programs are free consultations; their credit window of 0 days and their "no" in the credit and refund columns go with having no fee to credit or refund.
- The carpet and hard surface flooring programs charge 35.00 and the kitchen cabinet and countertop program charges 99.00 for the measure; on those three programs the fee is creditable against the contract price and refundable on a cancellation made with the required notice.
- The credit window is counted in calendar days after the measure is completed; the cancellation notice is counted in hours before the start of the measure appointment; the earliest appointment is counted in calendar days after the booking date.

## Program questions answered

**Which programs charge for the measure?** Ridgeline Carpet Installation and Ridgeline Hard Surface Flooring Installation at 35.00, and Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation at 99.00.

**Which program allows the longest period to sign and keep the measure fee credit?** Ridgeline Kitchen Cabinet and Countertop Installation, with 45 calendar days after the measure is completed.

**How early may a kitchen cabinet and countertop measure be set?** No earlier than 5 calendar days after the booking date.
